newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTE WINS FIM 45 MLN ASIAN ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: RAUTE WINS FIM 45 MLN ASIAN ORDERS.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Raute Oy said in a statement on Monday it won project orders worth a total of 45 million markka from Asian customers.
Most of the deliveries would take place next year, Raute said.

Two of the deals were agreed with a Japanese company for its projects in Thailand and Indonesia and the other deals were ordered by customers in Indonesia, Raute said, adding its Raute Precision Oy unit would handle the orders.
In 1995, the unit's net sales were 107 million markka. This year, its net sales are expected to "increase significantly," Raute said. In 1995, Raute's entire net sales were 783 million markka.
